charcoal.description: Body text — high contrast on light backgrounds.

warning.description: Yellow/amber for QC hold / attention needed.

bronze.description: Dark bronze — used sparingly for premium UI elements.

headings.usage: All headings, brand marks, dashboard titles. Condensed/compressed for maximum density. Uppercase for major headings.

body.usage: All body copy, UI text, form labels, navigation, cards.

monospace.usage: Measurement values (thickness, pH, temperature, cycle times), bath chemistry data, spec sheets, code snippets.

logo.clearance: Minimum 16px clear space around the logo on all sides.
logo.minimum_size: 32px height for icon-only, 120px width for horizontal lockup.
logo.usage: Full-color logo on white/light backgrounds. White logo on navy/charcoal backgrounds. Never apply shadows or effects directly to the logo mark.

logo_mark_description: Hexagonal mark with plating bath/barrel motif and ascending gradient bars. The hexagon references molecular chemistry (the science of plating). The internal vertical bars suggest both plating racks (parts hanging in a bath) and tracking/trending data. Colors: Navy (#1B2A4A) core, Copper (#C87533) accent.

trust_language.headline: Built by people who know the difference between bright tin and matte tin.
trust_language.durability: Every part tracked from barrel to box. Every process step recorded, timestamped, and tied to the operator who ran it. Nothing slips through the cracks because nothing gets handwritten and lost.
trust_language.precision: Specs down to the micron. ASTM B633, AMS QQ-N-290, customer-specific parameters — all stored with revision control, so operators always see the current approved cycle. No more outdated binder pages.
trust_language.reliability: Five-9s uptime for production-critical tracking. Real-time dashboards updated with every barcode scan. Automated C of C generation tied to QC signoffs — certifications generate the moment QC stamps approval.
trust_language.quality_promise: Your next ISO surveillance audit should take hours, not days. Every job's full lifecycle — from traveler to cert — in one retrievable, audit-ready record. That's not a feature. That's the baseline.

value_propositions.text: Replace the shop floor status walk and paper travelers with a real-time dashboard. Know where every job is — from barrel one to final shipping — without leaving your desk.
Automate C of C generation, bath chemistry trending, and audit-ready documentation. Your next ISO surveillance audit should take hours, not days.
Self-serve job status, download certification documents the moment QC signs off, and re-order repeat jobs with one click. No more phone tag.

copy.elevator_pitch: Plating Tracker is a job management and quality tracking system built for metal finishing shops. It replaces paper travelers with digital checkpoints, gives customers a self-serve portal for order status and certifications, and generates audit-ready documentation automatically. Think of it as the first software that actually understands how a plating shop works — because it was built for shops like yours.
copy.about_us:
Plating Tracker was built for the men and women who run metal finishing shops in the American industrial heartland. We know the difference between bright tin and matte tin. We know why an ASTM B633 callout matters. We know that the foreman who's been running the zinc line for 35 years has process knowledge that can't be replaced by a spreadsheet.

Our platform gives plating shops a simple, powerful way to track jobs, manage quality specs, generate certifications, and give customers real-time visibility — all without ripping out existing systems or retraining an experienced workforce.

Headquartered in Ashtabula County, Ohio — because the best industrial software comes from the people who live it.

service_descriptions.job_tracking: From receipt to shipping, every job gets a digital traveler. Scan a barcode at each process step — pretreatment, plating, inspection, QC hold, ship. Know exactly where every load is, in real time.
service_descriptions.spec_management: Store customer-specific plating specs with revision control. Operators always see the current approved cycle — never an outdated binder page. Supports ASTM, AMS, customer-specific, and military specs.
service_descriptions.quality_documentation: Automated Certificate of Compliance generation tied to QC checkpoint signoffs. Plating thickness reports, salt spray results, and inspection data — all pulled from the job's digital record, not recreated from paper.
service_descriptions.customer_portal: Your customers get a login. They place orders, upload part drawings, check job status, download certifications. Fewer phone calls for you. Better visibility for them.
service_descriptions.cert_generation_pro: One-click C of C generation with electronic signature. Audit-ready documentation packages for ISO, Nadcap, and customer audits. Every job's full lifecycle in one retrievable record.
service_descriptions.bath_chemistry_pro: Automatically graph pH, temperature, and concentration data from lab analysis. Detect drift before it causes a reject. Trend lines across weeks and months — not just the last panel.
service_descriptions.defect_heat_map_pro: See where defects cluster — by part type, plating line, operator shift, or cycle spec. Identify root causes instead of fighting symptoms.
service_descriptions.first_pass_yield_pro: Real-time first-pass yield dashboards. Spot processes trending toward reject thresholds before they produce scrap. Continuous improvement driven by live data, not monthly spreadsheets.
